nodes.label: Evaluation engine (evaluate)
nodes.rationale: One pure, deterministic, I/O-free TypeScript module (published graph, inputs) to resolved outputs + fired terminals + trace, so recommendations are unit-testable and trustworthy; runs server-side.
nodes.community_name: Design Spec: PRD, ADR & Rule-Graph Concepts

nodes.label: Publish validation
nodes.rationale: Blocking gate: DAG, inputs in flow catalog, contiguous non-overlapping bands, every path terminates, Fallback reachable, size-scoped template outputs, same-flow fallback beside every Flow route. Errors pin to offending node ids so a broken graph can never run live.
nodes.community_name: Design Spec: PRD, ADR & Rule-Graph Concepts

nodes.label: Input catalog (per flow)
nodes.rationale: Code-defined and typed per flow; a graph may only reference inputs its flow collects, and every input is required so Match nodes have no not-answered edge.
nodes.community_name: Design Spec: PRD, ADR & Rule-Graph Concepts

nodes.label: Bootstrap guard
nodes.rationale: Callers fall back to the current hardcoded rules only while a flow has no published graph; the guard is deleted once all three flows are seeded, making the cutover safe.

nodes.label: Staff assist mode
nodes.rationale: An assist-supplied spatial mix at hold create wins over the engine recommendation so live in-store fittings stay authoritative; the recommendation record is retained for analytics.

nodes.label: X-ray renderer
nodes.rationale: Read-only reuse of the spatial PRD x-ray renderer so there is exactly one renderer; legacy-flat templates gracefully degrade to the text mix summary, one designed-in swap point, no fork.
nodes.community_name: Design Spec: PRD, ADR & Rule-Graph Concepts

nodes.label: Reveal gate
nodes.rationale: Recommendation renders only on the completed preview once all required inputs are answered and any Flow route is resolved, so a real answer appears once and mid-wizard steps never show partial recommendations.

nodes.label: React Flow (@xyflow/react)
nodes.rationale: The PRD's one approved new dependency, adopted for the authoring canvas only; evaluation and validation stay dependency-free pure TS.
nodes.community_name: Design Spec: PRD, ADR & Rule-Graph Concepts

nodes.label: Single recommendation authority
nodes.rationale: The published graph is the one authority: online ballpark, in-store suggestion, and basic recommend all evaluate the same graph so surfaces never disagree about size again.
nodes.community_name: Design Spec: PRD, ADR & Rule-Graph Concepts

nodes.label: ADR 0010: Rules Engine is the single recommendation authority
nodes.rationale: Chosen over three divergent hardcoded engines and over LLM-driven authority because operators need to change logic without deploys, surfaces must never disagree, and every past recommendation must be explainable. Rejected: config table for thresholds (cannot express multi-measurement/branching/upsell), LLM authority (non-deterministic, unexplainable, bad clinical posture), and structured decision tables (product wanted a graph workbench for planned growth).
